'''3-SN4''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that worked as a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />
